name: How much does a kitchen addition typically cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen addition typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen addition in the Bay Area varies widely based on size, complexity, materials, and finishes chosen. Factors such as foundation work, utility relocation, structural changes, and high-end appliances can significantly impact the budget. While a small bump-out might start at $50,000, a complete new kitchen extension could range from $100,000 to over $300,000. It's crucial to get a detailed estimate from a general contractor after an on-site evaluation to understand the specific costs for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen addition costs in the Bay Area vary greatly, typically ranging from $50,000 for a small bump-out to over $300,000 for a large extension, depending on scope and materials.
